event_rule: Choose the smallest mask A in 0..255 maximizing Qstar(A)-sum(C[w] for w in A)/2800. Empty event allowed. Candidate design remains fixed.
validation: Independent physical target and candidate trials; score 1_A(target)-1_A(candidate).
scope: Expected signed score, width-one private candidate, blind source, actual marked target. Not a stored table or confidence guarantee.
